zh_cn.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.0: 放入有限电池；充电槽为空，不表示电池电量为零。
zh_cn.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.1: 充电器需要紧邻已放置的红石块，任一相邻方向均可。手持红石块和红石信号不能供电。
zh_cn.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.2: 正在从相邻红石块获得供电，数字显示电池当前余量。
zh_cn.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.3: 电池余量为1000，可以取走使用；无电源时仍保持满电状态。
zh_cn.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.4: 红石源存在，正在等候共享供电。电池已有余量保留。

en_us.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.0: Insert a finite battery. An empty slot is different from a battery with no charge.
en_us.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.1: Place a fixed redstone block beside the charger, on any of its six adjacent sides. Held blocks and redstone signals do not supply energy.
en_us.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.2: Receiving supply from an adjacent redstone block. The number shows the battery’s current charge.
en_us.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.3: The battery holds 1000 units and is ready to use. A full battery stays full without a source.
en_us.energy.wildcraft.screen.help.4: A redstone source is present. Waiting for its shared supply; the battery keeps its existing charge.
